# Goal
Kengaku lane, round 79 — wave w1 (v1, 14 seats: build + attack). You are ONE seat of this wave.
The round's two claims are FROZEN at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin/plans/round-79-claims.md (freeze commit `5d6843134017780c045e92eed4e83264188a7d47`); read it in full before any command. Never re-open a frozen predicate, target, control or kill rule.

R79-C1 (coverage, lowest non-retired axis, L0-capped at 7) = the whole 16-class Terminal-Bench 2.0 grader population (88 members, 230 member-class pairs, derived from `corpus/evidence/round62/class-survey.txt`) becomes a machine-checked member ledger at `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin/plans/grader-population-ledger.json`: every member accounted exactly once; `executed` rows name a tracked receipt that locates the member in a subject position and carries execution observations; `executed-unlocated` rows name the round's probe instrument + a receipt under that round + the `no-subject-stamp` debt; `unexecuted` rows name a blocker whose frozen detector fires over the task's `tests/test_outputs.py`, or the honest default `unattempted`. All 16 SKILL.md class rows carry a derived `executed k of n`. Counter: `plans/round79_c1_population_ledger.py`. Freeze reading: `LEDGER rows=88 executed=18 unlocated=6 unexecuted=64`, `COVERAGE replayed=24 covered=15 uncovered=container-image census_covered=12`, `DEFECTS n=0`, rc 0.

R79-C2 (calibration, held at ceiling 10, exercised) = the round-78 closure's seven routed defects (R78-D1…D7, `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin/corpus/lessons/round-78-verifier-spotcheck.md` §6) are discharged: one `corpus/routed-findings.jsonl` row each, status closed, a `source` resolving to the spot-check line, a `close` naming a tracked repair artifact (never the spot-check file) whose bytes carry the id, and a `check` that exits 0 only when the repair holds; `corpus/README.md` indexes the spot-check. Counter: `plans/round79_c2_closure_debt.py`. Before at base `660ec0b9`: `DEFECTS n=8`, `closed=0 checks_passed=0 indexed=no`, rc 1.

# Rules (binding on every seat)
- Write scope: your OWN scratch dir `$HYAKU_SCRATCH/kengaku-r79/<your-seat-name>/` with `HYAKU_SCRATCH` defaulting to `/fast/scratch/hyaku`, plus the single report file named by your `Report:` trailer. Everything else is READ-ONLY: never write, commit, push or run a mutating git/jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin, in the fleet repo, in a sibling lane, or in any domain source tree. No `git add/commit/stash/checkout/switch/reset/pull/push`, no mutating `jj`. Read-only git (`log`, `show`, `diff`, `status`, `ls-files`, `cat-file`, `rev-parse`, `merge-base`, `archive`) is fine. The lane's git HEAD is detached: read the tip with `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin rev-parse master`, never `@{u}` or `--abbrev-ref HEAD`.
- Every `Report:` trailer path the validator renders is RELATIVE TO /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin/<that path>.
- Git fixtures: any fixture repo is `D=$(mktemp -d "$HYAKU_SCRATCH/kengaku-r79/<seat>/XXXX") && git -C "$D" init -q`, and every later git call names `-C "$D"`; verify `git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals `$D` before the first commit. Never use a throwaway identity anywhere but inside such a fixture; never commit in the lane.
- Scratch discipline: everything you clone or build lives under `$HYAKU_SCRATCH/kengaku-r79/<seat>/`; delete it before you yield (`trap 'rm -rf -- "$S"' EXIT` in shell). `/tmp` is for files under 50 MB only and a `/tmp` path is never citable evidence.

You MAY run the committed counters read-only (they only read the lane) and you may run their `--selftest/--mutants/--control-*` modes with `--work` in your scratch.
- Tooling: you may install or upgrade tools that help your item; read `/home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md` first (official channels, update-safety gate) and record tool/version/channel/reason in your report. pacman is PAUSED host-wide: no `pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R`, no host service restarts; use `uv tool`/`npx`/an official binary in `~/.local/bin`, or report the blocker.
- Never call the `ask` tool; the round is unattended. Never spawn your own swarm. Do not message other seats; return findings in your report file.
